text:
maria: Heads up — saw intermittent 502s from Private customers during cert rotation window this morning. Suspect control-plane cert sync + route propagation delay. Anyone else?

sam: saw same. 502s for ~30s after we rotated CA on cp nodes in us-east-1. No errors in app logs, but tcp reset spikes.

ben: timeline? was there a peering/route-table change at the same time?

maria: rotation started 1714999800, route updates finished ~1714999835. 502s observed 1714999830-1714999860. So overlap.

irene: could be NAT translation rebind when endpoints bounce. Private endpoints are in customer VPCs via per-customer peering — got some ASG churn coinciding.

sam: hypothesis: client TLS session resumed to old node IP, but controlplane moved to new cert+IP before route propagated. Short TCP/TLS mismatch -> 502.

ben: two mitigations: 1) longer cert grace period where both certs valid, 2) keep IP stable during rotation (sticky ENI/Elastic IP). Both have cost/complexity tradeoffs.

maria: +3 to dual-cert approach. But how long is safe? We worry about attack window. Maybe 10m max?

irene: another angle: change how we roll—rotate control-plane pods in-place without changing node IPs using per-host sidecar. That avoids route churn but means more complex lifecycle.

sam: for Private, per-tenant peering increases config churn. What about using regional relay (single stable IP in our account) for controlplane egress and have customer endpoints talk to that? Relay gives us stable IP and single rotation surface.

ben: relay helps, but it's a different trust model (customer VPC -> our relay vs direct peering). Need to map implications: latency, cost, compliance (some customers require no egress to our account).

maria: exactly. We should classify customers: those that accept relay vs those requiring per-tenant peering. Propose: default to relay with fallback to per-tenant gateway for high-compliance customers.

irene: rollout plan idea: support short dual-cert overlap + health-check drain on nodes -> reduce visible 502s while we design relay. That buys us runway.

sam: agrees. Also add a canary that rotates certs while keeping one control plane replica pinned to old cert for X minutes.

ben: ops note: add metric "cp-cert-rotation-errors" and alert at >0.5% requests failing during rotation window.

maria: I'll open a follow-up RFC for "relay-first controlplane connectivity + per-tenant exceptions" and include migration plan + compliance checklist.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: cp-cert-rotation-v2 at 1715003000. No downtime expected. :package:

maria: thx — will coordinate with oncall. If we see issues we pause and revert. :thumbsup:
